But at-market R:R is poor: price 145.24 sits only ~1.9% above support 142.48 while a structural stop above resistance 148.82 sits ~2.4% away, giving well under 1.5:1. Prefer HOLD; would re-engage on a bounce into VWAP/resistance ~148 for a cleaner entry rather than shorting into support at market.
